package_entry_rule: Each packages entry maps a stable package ID to its package metadata path.
rules: Binary/native libraries use architecture-specific artifacts; pure-source or architecture-independent packages may use any/source.
A package ID is the stable machine-readable identifier used by registry clients.
Package names are human-facing and may differ from package IDs.
Clients should resolve package metadata through registry/index.json instead of hardcoding artifact URLs.
